description: This PHP script initializes and populates tracker data for a SuiteCRM module, generating fake monitoring records for various modules and actions to seed the database with sample data.

classes.name: populateSeedData
classes.description: A class responsible for populating tracker seed data by simulating user activity across different modules and actions.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes database connections, loads demo user data, retrieves module IDs, and generates a specified number of monitoring records with random attributes.

methods.name: populate_tracker
methods.description: Populates a tracker monitor instance with randomly selected user, module, action, and timestamp data, and saves it to the database.

methods.name: randomTimestamp
methods.description: Generates a random timestamp between a fixed start date and the current date.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a session ID for the current user, maintaining session continuity.
